name: Public Sector — Canada & USA
description: Public government and healthcare career boards in Canada and the USA. Coverage is bounded and varies by employer: GC Jobs and CalCareers require a local browser; Santé Québec covers its central board; Texas covers HHSC, DSHS and DFPS only. Ontario, Québec public service and Alberta Health Services remain visibly unavailable because their sources restrict access. This is a sector collection, not a workforce ranking.
